item.title: Over hanging leylandii branches. Obstructing street lamp that leaves the allyway in darkness so dogs poo not picked up. Between boverton avenue and boverton drive. The branches are overhanging the public path and into a neighbouring garden. This is dangerous. This is why the street lamp was installed. Its to dark to go into anyone could be loitering., 30th September
item.description:
These branches have over hung the ally way for several years. They stop the street light that is installed at the boverton drive end. It's really dark and people can't see to pick up after their dogs. I have removed the poo in the day light. But I shouldn't have to. If these branches were cut. And the height of the Leyland reduced the street lamp could do it's job to light the pathway. It's dangerous. And in the summer the foul smell from the dog poo is awful.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 31, Boverton Avenue, Coopers Edge, Gloucester
